title: Cargo workspace skeleton: all four members scaffolded (queen-bee, bee-core, queen-bench, bee-parity)
action: Create the cargo workspace at crates/ (per D4) with ALL FOUR members scaffolded as compilable stubs: bin crate queen-bee (subcommands `ping` prints pong exit 0, `--version`), lib crate bee-core (empty lib), bin crate queen-bench (stub main), bin crate bee-parity (stub main). The members list in crates/Cargo.toml is FINAL here so later cells never edit it (reservation-collision fix, validation B1). Release profile per approach.md: lto="fat", codegen-units=1, panic="abort", strip=true. Commit crates/Cargo.lock. Append `crates/target/` to .gitignore OUTSIDE (below) the `# BEE:START`/`# BEE:END` managed fence — the fence is regenerated on every onboard and anything inside it is wiped (onboard_bee.mjs GITIGNORE_BLOCK_PATTERNS). D8 note: local target is x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; the musl static target is deliberately deferred to Slice 6 — the Slice-0 perf floor is recorded as provisional on gnu (audit decision).
